bio: Centrally located on London's South Bank, next to The London Eye, with breathtaking views overlooking Big Ben & the River Thames, the luxury 5-star Marriott County Hall is traditionally elegant.  Originally used as a seat of government, County Hall was was opened in 1922 by King George V. The building has been restored yet has kept its beautiful architecture including it's original wooden floor and panneling.  The Library Lounge at Marriott County Hall Hotel features stunning views of Big Ben, The Houses of Parliament and the River Thames, all of which can be enjoyed whilst taking Afternoon Tea.
